IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Thursday 19 November
Winds: South to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots decreasing to about 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Friday 20 November
Winds: North to northeasterly about 10 knots tending east to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon then becoming north to northeasterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and early evening.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming southerly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming variable below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.

Sunday 22 November

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Monday 23 November
Winds: Northwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending westerly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system sits to the east of Tasmania, with a ridge to the south of Tasmania expected to weaken overnight. A low pressure system over the Bight will move to the southwest of Tasmania during Friday, with an associated trough to cross the state early on Saturday morning. A narrow ridge of high pressure will cross Tasmania overnight Saturday, ahead of a strong cold front to cross late Sunday and early Monday. A trough is expected to cross Tasmania during Monday and bring a cold southwesterly change.

IDT12326.text:

Friday 20 November

Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres.

Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm inshore in the afternoon and early evening.

Saturday 21 November

Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning, then increasing to 1 to 2 metres around midday.

Seas: 1 to 2 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the evening.
